items.a: apptivity.id is an Indonesian software house under PT Lawson Semesta Indonesia. We build web and mobile apps with clear pricing, open progress, and a money-back guarantee. We call our clients Sahabat — partners, not just buyers.

items.q: Buy or rent — which fits me?
items.a: Choose Buy if you want to own and change the app anytime, with no charges after close. Choose Rent for light upfront cost: small additions free, built-in server and domain free, just a yearly fee. Both include free consultation for clients and Primary Affiliator registration.
On the Buy scheme, the source code is yours and fully handed over on final payment. On the Rent scheme, the app stays managed by Apptivity during the rental period.
Four steps: free consultation with no obligation, a written agreement in a contract, regularly reported progress until done, and a money-back guarantee if results miss the agreement.

items.q: What if results don't match the agreement?
items.a: We refund the value of the features that miss the agreement. Conversely, out-of-scope requests are discussed openly from the start.

items.q: Is there support after the project ends?
items.a: Yes. Apptivity clients get free consultation. Fixes within the 30-day warranty after handover are free. New features are discussed openly.
Yes. We operate under PT Lawson Semesta Indonesia (single-shareholder company). Every transaction is recorded and taxes reported.

privasi.description: Apptivity.id privacy policy under Indonesia's PDP Law No. 27/2022: data collected, purpose, retention, and your rights.
privasi.intro: Apptivity (PT Lawson Semesta Indonesia) respects your privacy. This page explains what data we collect through this site, why, and your rights — under Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law No. 27 of 2022. Last updated: October 2026.

blocks.body: Only data you provide yourself through the 3-step brief form:
points: Your / company name
Active WhatsApp number or email
Your project needs in your own words
App type and ownership plan choice (Buy/Rent)

blocks.body: Your data is used solely to follow up on your needs:
points: Contacting you via WhatsApp for a free consultation
Preparing estimates and the written agreement
Official company transaction records and tax reporting

blocks.body: This site uses a single functional cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) to remember your language choice — not a tracking cookie, no consent needed. Visit statistics use cookieless analytics that does not identify individuals.
Brief messages are forwarded to our WhatsApp and kept as long as needed for service and company record obligations. We never sell or share your data with third parties for marketing.
Under the PDP Law you may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data. Reach us at the email below.
PT Lawson Semesta Indonesia — email: lawsonsemestaindonesia@gmail.com, WhatsApp: +62 812-7038-9862.
